concerns.text: The core research question asks whether SNP counts and MGE proximity provide *incremental predictive value* for real bacterial antibiotic resistance. The plan evaluates this claim using a fully synthetic dataset that is generated deterministically to “mimic the structure of real NCBI Pathogen Browser and CARD data”. Because the synthetic phenotype‑genotype relationships are defined by the data‑generation script, any observed improvement of the integrated model over the baseline is guaranteed (or pre‑determined) by the simulation design rather than reflecting an independent biological signal. This makes the validation target (model performance on the synthetic data) *not independent* of the predictors, resulting in a circular/tautological validation of the hypothesis.
